title: Self-audit across the query family and fixed-task capability audits
description: The Family Module of the Self-Audit Module holds that single-rendering self-audit cannot see distributed erasure, audits attribution across a query family through FC, ASI and CC, reserves a family composite until corpus runs exist, and prescribes a synthetic-family repair. Fixed-task capability audits would test capacity loss before and after a model retuning with the user held constant. Also here are cross-system PER measurement, subjunctive semantic addresses awaiting observation, and the claim that models trained on anthologies inherit the apparatus's erasure.
